unsupported_i16_opcode.scope: Read-only installed ROCm7.1 llvm-mc check for gfx1151; no GPU execution or inference. It rejects v_dot2_i32_i16, so this candidate uses supported FP16 DOT2 plus IU8 residue.

reference.title: AMD RDNA3.5 Instruction Set Architecture Reference Guide
reference.scope: Instruction availability, operand interpretation and pseudocode. No universal single-rounding or error-bound proof is inferred from these descriptions.

implementation: Two original signed BF16 significands shifted0..7 are exact normal FP16 core integers, each at most32640 in magnitude. Native zero-C FP16 DOT2 estimates their integer product sum. Native IU8 DOT4 on the two signed low bytes supplies an exact modulo256 residue. The nearest compatible integer is accepted with explicit range and midpoint rejection; exact individual signed residues then reconstruct original per-product truncation for shifts0..8.
correctness_scope: Four finite families cover pair-relative minimum exponents, all two-varying mantissas at maximum scale with sign combinations, near/exact cancellation and independent full shift ranges. Every accepted integer and nine truncation results match independently formed signed CPU products. Both native launches agree; complete input/output guards and immutable operands pass. Maximum observed error64 is below the conditional128 recovery threshold. Input rows can repeat within these families;4194304 is tested cases, not a deduplicated-domain claim.
decision: Continue to an isolated ordered-K16 and captured operator comparison. The primitive has no runtime dispatcher, complete dot, GB10 operator comparison, TTFT result or inference qualification. Keep the qualified product control unchanged.
